name: 成本（控制/优化/分析）体系

map.成本（控制/优化/分析）体系是做什么的？: What does Cost Optimization & Analysis System do?
map.如何使用成本（控制/优化/分析）体系？: How do I use Cost Optimization & Analysis System?
map.成本（控制/优化/分析）体系适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Cost Optimization & Analysis System best for?
map.📖 查看「成本（控制/优化/分析）体系使用指南」: 📖 View the "Cost Optimization & Analysis System Guide"
map.本工具按固定/变动与单位/总口径拆解成本结构，输出可控项与降本优先级，结果仅供参: This tool breaks the cost structure down by fixed/variable and per-unit/total bases and outputs controllable items and cost-reduction priorities; the result is for reference only, and formal budgeting should follow the financial policy and latest regulations.
map.每行输入「成本项,金额」，如：原料,42: Enter one cost item per line as "item,amount", e.g. raw material,42
map.把各项成本金额贴入，看合计与均值，定位占比最大的成本项。: Paste the amount of each cost item to see the total and mean and locate the item with the largest share.
map.对比本期与上期成本，用极差判断是普遍上升还是个别项异常拉高。: Compare this period's cost with the previous period and use the range to judge whether the rise is broad or driven by one abnormal item.
map.汇总多个供应商报价，用: Summarize quotes from several suppliers and use the
map.判断哪家偏高、哪家更具性价比。: to judge which is high and which offers better value.
map.原料 42 万、人工 31 万、物流 15 万、能耗 9 万合计 97 万：原料: Raw material 420,000, labor 310,000, logistics 150,000 and energy 90,000, totalling 970,000: raw material accounts for 43%; optimization should start with the highest-share item, raw material, rather than spreading effort evenly.
map.多项成本怎么分组？: How should multiple cost items be grouped?
map.可分次贴入（如分部门或分产品线）分别统计，再横向比较占比，避免混在一起看不出结构: Paste them in batches (for example by department or product line) and analyse each separately, then compare the shares side by side, so the structure is not obscured by mixing them together.
map.能自动归类成本项吗？: Can it categorize cost items automatically?
map.不能。页面按数值统计，成本归类与科目口径需你自行设定并保持前后一致。: No. The page works on the numbers as given; you must define the cost grouping and category basis yourself and keep them consistent.
map.只看总额够吗？: Is looking only at the total enough?
map.不够。总额反映规模，还需结合均值、极差与占比看结构，才能找到真正的优化空间。: No. The total reflects scale; you also need the mean, range and shares to see the structure and find real room for optimization.
map.按固定/变动与单位/总口径拆解成本结构，定位可控优化项与降本空间。: Break the cost structure down by fixed/variable and per-unit/total bases to locate controllable optimization items and room for cost reduction.
